verdict.rationale: Phaser ships an official 'Game Agent' MCP server (phaser.io/agent/mcp) explicitly designed so users 'describe what you want in plain language and your agent calls the tools for you,' with example natural-language commands like 'Give the player a double-jump and a coin counter' and integration with Claude Desktop, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. This is corroborated by a runtime probe confirming the hosted MCP endpoint is live and documented. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party confirmation of the MCP agent's reliability and no published @phaserjs npm MCP package, only a hosted endpoint.
